title: Luxury Three Story East Nashville Townhouse
description:
It's the best of both worlds.  Enjoy the peace and quiet of the new spacious condos with high ceilings and luxury finishes.  Or get excited about all the diverse activities the neighborhood has to offer with a coffee shop and brewery right next door!  Or venture out further, as Broadway and East Nashville are just a 10-minute drive away.

The space
INCLUDED WITH YOUR STAY:
- 2-car garage
- 24/7 hospitality
- Smart TV

INTERNET
Our high-speed internet is designed for work and streaming

SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS
1st-floor bedroom: 1 Queen Beds 
3rd-floor bedroom 1: 2 Queen Beds + en suite bathroom
3rd-floor bedroom 2: 1 Queen Bed + en suite bathroom
Second Floor Living room: 1 Sleeper Sofa.

Pets allowed with $200 pet fee.
Parking for 2 cars. The Complex has extra parking but only for the day.

Guest access
You will have access to the entire condo.

Other things to note
1st Floor: Garage and Bedroom w/ Queen Bed

2nd Floor: Living Area, Chef's kitchen, dining area, and full bath (Queen Sleep Sofa)

3rd Floor: Master Bedroom w/ two queen beds and private bath, Laundry Room, and Bedroom w/ Queen Bed
